episodes.synopsis: The world is shaken by news of a man taking down a monstrous elephant with his bare hands. Back in Japan, Baki is confronted by a knife-wielding child.
episodes.title: The World's Strongest Senior

episodes.synopsis: To train for his eventual battle against his father, Baki spars against an imaginary giant praying mantis he’s created in his mind.
episodes.title: Mixed species' martial arts

episodes.synopsis: In the middle of a heavily guarded parade, the President of the United States is kidnapped in plain sight by an unknown young man.
episodes.title: Prison and Hell

episodes.synopsis: Baki comes across a man known as “Mr. Second,” a powerful inmate who seems to enjoy special privileges within the prison.
episodes.title: The Second

episodes.synopsis: With just a few weeks left on his sentence, Iron Michael is attacked by triplet hit men hired to make sure the ex-boxing champ never fights again.
episodes.title: Terrible Triplets

episodes.synopsis: Just as the Mouth triplets are about to finish their attack on Iron Michael, Guevaru rolls in and instigates a fight.
episodes.title: Man of the Sea

episodes.synopsis: Guevaru refuses to believe that Biscuit Oliva, the most notorious inmate in the prison, is comfortably serving his sentence in the company of his lover.
episodes.title: Hyper male and Hyper male

episodes.synopsis: The match between Guevaru and Oliva begins, and the rules are simple: They both hold onto the same piece of cloth and the first one to let go loses.
episodes.title: Gilberto Style

episodes.synopsis: Guevaru is fighting for the people of his impoverished homeland, and he won’t go down so easily. Later, Oliva makes a discovery.
episodes.title: Decision Time

episodes.synopsis: Baki is surrounded by guards with their guns pointed right at him, but he doesn’t seem worried at all — he seems to be planning something.
episodes.title: Can't you laugh?

episodes.synopsis: Oliva inadvertently kicks off a major incident when he enters Baki’s solitary confinement cell to challenge him to a fight in two weeks' time.
episodes.title: The Prison Guard talks about it

episodes.synopsis: Baki learns the hard way that he might not be ready to fight the man known as “Mr. Unchained” — Oliva’s power and technique are on another level.
episodes.title: Beyond the Brawn
